source:
For something this large, Roblox Build will do much better if you give it both a layout diagram and a strict building specification.

Here's a simple top-down layout you can copy into Build:

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| KSG TRAINING FACILITY |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

[Parking] [Main Gate] [Security Checkpoint]

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Reception | Waiting | Front Office | Briefing Room | Staff Offices | Server Room |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Lockers | Medical | Bathrooms | Armory | Equipment | Break Room |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Classroom | Classroom | Classroom | Simulation Room | Control Room | CCTV Room |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Indoor Shooting Range (10 Lanes) | Weapons Storage | Cleaning Area |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CQB / Kill House | Breaching House | Hallways | Tactical Village |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Gym | Obstacle Course | Training Yard | Vehicle Training Area |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Then tell the AI to follow these building rules:

Every room must have a solid concrete floor (at least 1 stud thick).

Anchor every floor so players cannot fall through.

Every room must have four full-height walls.

Every room must have a complete roof and ceiling.

No gaps beside doors.

Doors must fit tightly inside the wall frame.

Walls must have collisions enabled.

Floors, roofs, and stairs must all have collisions enabled.

Laptops should sit on desks in the Front Office, Control Room, Staff Offices, Reception, and Briefing Room.

Add chairs, filing cabinets, lockers, CCTV monitors, desks, lights, vents, and emergency exits.

Use realistic concrete, steel, and industrial materials.

Scale the map realistically with wide hallways and large rooms.

Do not generate cartoon buildings or low-poly parts.


This should stop the issues where:

You fall through the floor.

Doors have gaps you can walk through.

Buildings have missing roofs.

Half-height walls appear.

Furniture floats or clips through the floor.


For a project like this, I'd also recommend generating one building at a time (for example, Reception, then the Shooting Range, then the CQB building) and connecting them afterward. Roblox Build is much more reliable with smaller sections than trying to generate an entire military base in one prompt.

answers.ask: Roughly how large should the whole compound be - a few hundred studs across, or a full military-base footprint?
answers.answer: Keep it to a few hundred studs across: a compact, realistically scaled training facility rather than a full military-base footprint.

answers.ask: Is this a playable game, a group training map, or a static build to walk around?
answers.answer: This is a group training map that players can walk around and use for organized training.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: Roughly how large should the whole compound be - a few hundred studs across, or a full military-base footprint? A: Keep it to a few hundred studs across: a compact, realistically scaled training facility rather than a full military-base footprint.
- [author] goal — Q: Is this a playable game, a group training map, or a static build to walk around? A: This is a group training map that players can walk around and use for organized training.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a compact realistic KSG group-training facility a few hundred studs across, following the supplied row-based plan. Begin with Parking, Main Gate, and Security Checkpoint. The main building contains Reception, Waiting, Front Office, Briefing Room, Staff Offices, Server Room; Lockers, Medical, Bathrooms, Armory, Equipment, Break Room; three Classrooms, Simulation Room, Control Room, CCTV Room; then an Indoor Shooting Range with exactly 10 lanes, Weapons Storage, and Cleaning Area. Connect onward to a CQB/Kill House, Breaching House, wide Hallways, Tactical Village, Gym, Obstacle Course, Training Yard, and Vehicle Training Area. Use realistic concrete, steel, and industrial materials, never cartoon or low-poly styling. Every room has a solid anchored concrete floor at least one stud thick, four full-height collidable walls, a complete roof and ceiling, and tightly fitted doors with no gaps. Keep all floors, roofs, stairs, and walls collidable; place furniture firmly on floors. Put laptops on desks in Reception, Front Office, Staff Offices, Briefing Room, and Control Room, plus chairs, filing cabinets, lockers, CCTV monitors, lights, vents, and emergency exits.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Shooter because organized range, CQB, and breaching training define the facility.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, named Open World, from outside Shooter's usual shapes: the compound is one contiguous facility whose indoor and outdoor training zones can be visited in any order. Preset is none; neither Aim Trainer nor Tactical Shooter covers the full mixed-use compound.

## Config requirements
Use `building-interior` for the complete room network entered from the compound. Use `path-circulation` for wide hallways and outdoor links. Use `target-practice` for the exactly 10 indoor firing lanes and `station-loadout` for armory, equipment, weapons-storage, and cleaning stations. Use `cover-los` in the CQB/Kill House, Breaching House, and Tactical Village. Use `path-track` plus `obstacle-climb` for the training obstacle course, `path-road-vehicle` for the vehicle area, and `settlement-density` for the compact Tactical Village.

## Layout requirements
Place the `target-practice` side as 10 lane-aligned target positions, one per firing lane. Place `station-loadout` interactions at the Armory, Equipment room, Weapons Storage, and Cleaning Area. Use one `spawn-area` arrival beside Parking before the Main Gate and Security Checkpoint. No scoring or match objective volumes are required.

## Layout components
Preserve every named room and zone in the supplied order, including exactly three Classrooms and 10 shooting lanes. Interior rooms connect by wide halls; CQB, breaching, village, gym, obstacle, yard, and vehicle zones form the rear training band. Parking and security form the front boundary. All stated structural and collision rules are hard build constraints.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: the supplied row plan, room adjacencies, 10 lanes, and outdoor training connections are authoritative before isometric dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is medium because the compound is a few hundred studs across while furniture and doors remain legible. The theme is realistic concrete-and-steel industrial training architecture. Use `P3` for exterior-to-interior traversal and `P6` for the obstacle course's valid route.
